source_pdf.title: NACA TN 1594, Experimental Investigation of the Effects of Concentrated Weights on Flutter Characteristics of a Straight Cantilever Wing
source_pdf.authors: Harry L. Runyan and John L. Sewall
source_pdf.method: Manual transcription by visually inspecting PyMuPDF rendered pages and targeted crops. Embedded OCR was used only to locate surrounding explanatory text. No simulations, mode matching, or upstream data were used to repair unreadable source digits.

columns: f_h1: natural first bending frequency at zero airspeed
f_h2: natural second bending frequency at zero airspeed
f_t: natural first torsional frequency at zero airspeed
source_semantics.before_after_interpretation: The report test procedure (PDF page 6 / printed page 5) states natural frequencies were tabulated before and after most runs to determine whether flutter damaged the wing. Row ordering and zero indicated speed distinguish before/after measurements. Absent phase means no corresponding zero-speed observation is printed; it is not a zero frequency.
source_semantics.dashes: Dash cells denote an unreported quantity. The number of printed dash segments is not counted; normalized transcription is --- .
source_semantics.gas: All weight-7 test rows have percentage of Freon-12 = 0; the test medium is therefore air. The unweighted run 5 test has 90.8% Freon-12. The source table writes zeros in the surrounding zero-speed flow-condition fields; these are not used to infer additional natural-frequency measurement medium details.
source_semantics.no_flutter: Printed flutter frequency 0 plus a divergence remark is a no-flutter case, not a 0-Hz natural frequency.
source_semantics.mode_labels: Mode columns are preserved as actually printed. No relabeling by ordering or by simulation is performed.
source_semantics.uncertainty: Source-says-Not-clear values remain null. Unusual but legible changes remain as printed. No interpolation supplies missing observations.

method.experimental_comparison: Sort each complete printed B1/B2/T triplet; compare with lowest three computed spectral ranks. Preserve printed labels, phase and every source cell.
method.kinetic_shape_mapping: h=u_y+ea_x*theta_z; dh=-theta_x; phi=theta_z; translations use state_layout translation_scale.
method.kinetic_metric: Distributed structural mass at cg_x, Icc*dh^2, Ip*phi^2, strip-air mass at chord/2 and strip-air pitch inertia, plus exact concentrated point contributions.
method.quadrature: Four-point Gauss on union of native/reference nodes; native nodal linear fields and reference Hermite bending/linear torsion.

limitations: Density 1.225 kg/m^3 is an explicit assumption, not recovered zero-speed laboratory density. Zero-speed Freon entries and separate flutter-test mixtures remain distinct.
Inviscid incompressible thin-strip added mass includes neither fluid damping nor finite-span, thickness, viscosity, wall or compressibility corrections.
Sectional rotary-inertia endpoints are conditional geometric bounds, not a complete experimental uncertainty interval; fixture and pylon properties remain incompletely specified.
Equivalent point pairs omit unreported pylon bending inertia and spanwise CG offsets; in-plane bending is constrained.
All six numerical frequencies retain order. Low diagonal higher-mode MAC may reflect a near-degenerate pair or exchanged shape order; no relabeling or accuracy-threshold relaxation is applied.

Earlier source-pinned 7f/48 upper N32 controls found mode6/7 individual MAC about0.352, despite pair-space squared principal cosines above0.9998. The mode split and individual shapes were not converged; this is not a blanket explanation for other cases.
The six-root reference cannot diagnose native mode6 versus reference mode7. Dedicated eight-mode pair diagnostics are required for that question.
Residual/reference tolerances are numerical controls. No experimental frequency-error or shape-MAC acceptance threshold has been established.
All72 complete triplets are eligible. Every before/after observation and all6 Not-clear cells remain separate; no missing measurements are inferred.

prior_higher_pair_diagnostic.scope: Three earlier candidate controls only; not a test of every current configuration.

report.scope: Existing saved N32 A/M only; native eigensystem count16 yields8 positive poles. Independent reciprocal FE256 recomputed at count8 and explicit rho1.225. No mode relabeling, matrix reassembly, threshold relaxation, or experimental pairing.
